name: fafo-resolve
description: Merge conflicts adjudicated by TypeSafe Jev — code enumerates candidates, Jev picks, low confidence escalates.

fafo.apiKey.markdownDescription: TypeSafe API key. `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` in the environment takes precedence. Stored only in VS Code settings — never written to SecretStorage or disk by this extension.

fafo.minConfidence.markdownDescription: Escalate a hunk when the winning pick's confidence is below this (with corroborating weak signals).

fafo.minCoverage.markdownDescription: Escalate when the coverage judgment (correct resolution is among the enumerated candidates) falls below this.

fafo.minVerify.markdownDescription: Reject the winning candidate when its verification noul falls below this.

fafo.noVerify.markdownDescription: Skip per-candidate verification nouls (fewer questions per ask, weaker gating).

fafo.decompose.markdownDescription: Retry escalated hunks as per-window sub-conflicts before giving up.

fafo.maxWindows.markdownDescription: Max sub-regions a hunk may split into when decomposing.

fafo.contextLines.markdownDescription: Lines of surrounding file context included in the state sent to Jev.

fafo.model.markdownDescription: Model override passed through to the request (empty = SDK default / `TYPESAFE_DEFAULT_MODEL`).
